channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: S&P 500 correction: Five forces behind the market sell-off
item.description: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in correction territory, off 10% from their records. The Nasdaq Composite lost its gain for the year.

item.title: UK maritime agency reports two tanker attacks near Oman; Iran says vessel hit mine east of Hormuz
item.description: The incidents followed a similar attack on a tanker near Khasab on Friday that caused a fire on board, according to the British maritime security agency.

item.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
item.description: Once the most valuable company in the world, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

item.title: How China is using summits to expand its global influence
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has helped coordinate yet another photo-op of global significance.

item.title: International first class is over for U.S. airlines. Enter the mega business-class cabin
item.description: Airlines are opting to build giant business-class cabins with ever-more luxurious suites.

item.title: Is the bull market cracking? What to watch for next week after the AI washout
item.description: The stock market may be nearer to a bottom after this week's sell-off, but investors are still bracing for further volatility.

item.title: Trump orders federal contractors to notify White House before giving Congress information
item.description: Companies that fail to comply could face cancelation of existing contracts or suspension from future federal business.

item.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor
item.description: Cybersecurity companies have been hunting for acquisitions in the AI era.

item.title: An early breakdown in the polar vortex is threatening already depleted gas stocks
item.description: Colder weather and low wind speeds could strain Europe’s gas market, where storage started winter at its lowest level in more than a decade.

item.title: Why Anthropic's blockbuster IPO couldn't escape the market correction
item.description: Anthropic's IPO was a big public market success for the company, but Friday's selloff shows that valuing the AI stock will remain volatile for investors.

item.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Lutnick
item.description: President Donald Trump, when asked by CNBC's Eamon Javers, said he has not lost confidence in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

item.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
item.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced a flurry of criticism on Capitol Hill in the wake of his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: A massive bearish trade just happened in the chip stocks
item.description: Options traders place big bets that semiconductor stocks have further to fall

item.title: Take-Two shatters sales record as 'GTA VI' launches to massive fanfare
item.description: "GTA VI" helped Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of the game that is now a global cultural phenomenon, rake in nearly $4 billion in first-day sales.

item.title: FBI's criminal information database hacked, CNN reports
item.description: The apparent compromise of the National Crime Information Center database would mark the second intrusion involving an FBI system in recent months.

item.title: Europe's cyber weak spot is the everyday businesses nobody thought to protect
item.description: Known vulnerabilities are leaving everyday businesses increasingly exposed to cyber sabotage, as AI enables cybercriminals to work better and faster.

item.title: Countries agree to U.N. talks aiming to regulate 'killer robots' by 2028
item.description: Around 100 countries backed legally binding rules within a short timeframe but big arms-producing nations like the U.S., Russia and Israel opposed this position.

item.title: Meta's India offices hit by opposition protests over account removals
item.description: Prime Minister Modi's government says it orders content to be taken down only if it breaches local laws, or can harm public safety or national security.

item.title: AI is changing software engineering — and some developers miss the struggle
item.description: AI coding tools are making software engineers faster, but developers tell CNBC the work has lost its "sense of joy and fun."

item.title: Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'
item.description: Trump spoke at the White House after meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin for a historic trilateral summit in China.

item.title: Intensifying AI rout wipes out Nasdaq's 2026 gains. Alphabet is a tech bright spot
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch, an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Traveling soon? Here’s how to decide whether to fly or drive
item.description: CNBC Select compares driving vs. flying some of the most popular travel routes and what to consider before deciding.

item.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
item.description: Odds that the S&P 500 will cross 8,000, which were once north of 70%, are extremely low on platform Kalshi.

item.title: As Anthropic shares tank, investors scramble to hedge. It could be very expensive
item.description: Anthropic options list Monday. They will likely be expensive

item.title: Data center construction costs soar 13% in 2026
item.description: The demand for large data centers in the U.S. this year, driven by AI needs, grew beyond the supply of powered land and the labor to build these structures.

item.title: Warsh wants Fed officials to talk less. Instead, they’re talking more
item.description: Fed officials have been rushing to the microphones lately while the Fed chairman stays on the sidelines.

item.title: Ex-GM CEO on Mary Barra succession planning: 'It's going to be tough'
item.description: Former GM CEO Dan Akerson says whoever replaces Mary Barra will have a difficult task because they'll inherit rapid change in technology and the auto industry.

item.title: Trump says he discussed Jensen Huang with Xi; Bessent tells CNBC Nvidia chip export policy is unchanged
item.description: Trump said he discussed Jensen Huang with China's Xi. Bessent said the ousted Nvidia CEO didn't come up in talks he had while in China.

item.title: Anthropic was supposed to save the AI trade. What went wrong?
item.description: Technology stocks tanked despite one of the most hotly anticipated tech IPOs in years. Why Anthropic couldn't revive AI animal spirits.

item.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, says Old Navy turnaround is seeing signs of progress
item.description: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.
